Property.Name: BodyScript
QueryScript
Property.Value: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.url, a.published_date, a.scraped_date, a.language, a.author, a.category, s.name AS source_name, s.base_url AS source_base_url, s.country AS source_country FROM news_articles a INNER JOIN news_sources s ON a.source_id = s.id WHERE s.is_active = 1
